page0.text:
...I can't move.
"Run, if you can!" I'm not obedient enough to do as she says.
But at the same time, I can't go after Berserker either.

page1.text:
I'm scared to face that monster.
More importantly, even if I did go, what would I be able to do?

page2.text:
"Damn...it..."
I stand there by myself, alone in the darkness.
...I hate to admit it, but I don't have the strength to fight.
I can't save Saber or fight Berserker.
If there's anything I can do, it's escape to safety before it's too late.

page3.text:
"!?"
From above the hill—the barren land where Saber was flung to—I hear unfamiliar noises.

page4.text:
...If I recall correctly, that's the foreigners' cemetery.
Saber and Berserker.
They're still fighting.
